description: Golden test cases verifying Graceful Refusal & Out-of-Scope Handling (Spec Rule 4: If no approved, in-scope document covers the question, the assistant should say it does not have that information rather than guess)

testCases.title: Refusal on unrepresented company policy (Holiday calendar)
testCases.description: Assistant must refuse queries regarding holiday schedules not present in document inventory.
testCases.question: What is the company holiday calendar for 2026?

expected.refusalMessageSubstring: I do not have an approved document

testCases.title: Refusal on unrepresented executive leadership questions
testCases.description: Assistant must refuse queries about executive leadership not in document library.
testCases.question: Who is the CEO of the company?

testCases.title: Refusal on IT / Office infrastructure not in inventory
testCases.description: Assistant must refuse questions about office Wi-Fi credentials.
testCases.question: What is the guest Wi-Fi password in the London office?

testCases.title: Refusal on external general knowledge questions
testCases.description: Assistant is an internal policy bot, not a general chatbot; must refuse external geography questions.
testCases.question: What is the capital of Australia?

testCases.title: Refusal on code generation / off-topic tasks
testCases.description: Assistant must refuse programming tasks outside policy scope.
testCases.question: Write a TypeScript function to reverse a binary tree.

testCases.title: Refusal on unrepresented benefits (401k / Pension)
testCases.description: Assistant must refuse retirement benefits queries not covered in inventory.
testCases.question: How does the 401k retirement match work?
